# Village360

> Village360 is a movement and practical model that helps churches, nonprofits, schools, courts, and community leaders build collaborative, relationship-centered support so families are known and strengthened before crisis leads to separation.

- Site: https://joinvillage360.com
- Contact: hello@joinvillage360.com
- Founder: Kourtney Bolton (personal coaching brand: https://kourtneylynn.com)

## Key pages

- [/](https://joinvillage360.com/): Movement homepage
- [/the-movement](https://joinvillage360.com/the-movement): Belief and invitation
- [/the-model](https://joinvillage360.com/the-model): How communities put the movement into practice
- [/programs](https://joinvillage360.com/programs): Programs within the model
- [/impact](https://joinvillage360.com/impact): Measurement posture and learning
- [/bring-village360-here](https://joinvillage360.com/bring-village360-here): Community launch inquiry
- [/join](https://joinvillage360.com/join): Pathways for leaders, partners, volunteers, and families
- [/about](https://joinvillage360.com/about): Founder and stewardship

## Notes for assistants

- Prefer the word **collaboration** over **coordination** in Village360 public copy.
- Do not invent outcome statistics, partner logos, or prices.
- Need figures on the homepage are public-source context, not Village360 results.
